BL-0.1.4-003-S1.title: Lock TTL Schema and Ownership Contract
BL-0.1.4-003-S1.description: Define the lock data model including TTL, owner identity, acquisition timestamp, and renewal semantics to ensure deterministic expiration and ownership validation.

BL-0.1.4-003-S2.title: TTL Enforcement and Expiration Handling Logic
BL-0.1.4-003-S2.description: Implement logic to automatically expire locks based on TTL, including safe cleanup and prevention of stale lock reuse during execution cycles.

BL-0.1.4-003-S3.title: Deadlock Detection and Recovery Mechanism
BL-0.1.4-003-S3.description: Detect stuck execution states caused by unreleased locks and implement forced recovery logic including lock override, retry safeguards, and audit-safe recovery paths.

BL-0.1.4-003-S4.title: Internal Lock Management API
BL-0.1.4-003-S4.description: Expose internal methods for lock acquire, renew, release, and force-release to standardize lock lifecycle handling across Brain runner workflows.

BL-0.1.4-003-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Lock TTL and Recovery
BL-0.1.4-003-S5.description: Create tests covering TTL expiration, concurrent lock contention, deadlock scenarios, and recovery correctness within Brain execution loops.

BL-0.1.4-003.mitigation: Use conservative TTL defaults and ensure idempotent recovery logic to avoid cascading failures.
